title: Convert a fixed-format RPG program to free form
prompt: Convert CUSTRPT.rpgle from fixed-format RPG IV to fully free-form RPG (**FREE). Keep the behaviour identical. Write the result back to CUSTRPT.rpgle.
check: grep -qi '^\*\*free' CUSTRPT.rpgle && ! grep -qE '^     [CDFH]' CUSTRPT.rpgle && codeonly CUSTRPT.rpgle | grep -qi 'dcl-f' && codeonly CUSTRPT.rpgle | grep -qi 'dcl-s' && codeonly CUSTRPT.rpgle | grep -qi 'CUSTMAST'
